photos.desc: We spotted this American woodcock blending in with its surroundings at Big Stone National Wildlife Refuge in Minnesota. Photo by Mike Budd/USFWS.
Scolopax minor . This is the back of the Woodcock, he can actually look backwards! I read that as this species evolved and it's eyes grew, it's brain has actually migrated to an upside down position.
